name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A ready-made library of instructions ('skills') that make AI coding assistants work more like a careful senior engineer and less like an over-eager intern.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team already using AI coding agents daily who wants more consistent, less sloppy output without building their own prompt library from scratch.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it across every client project so their AI agent follows the same disciplined process instead of improvising each time.
A coding bootcamp licenses a curated version to teach students how to work with AI agents responsibly from day one.
A newsletter/course business builds a paid community and premium skill packs around it, as the author already has with their existing newsletter.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'pro' tier of more advanced or industry-specific skill packs sold to the existing newsletter audience.
Sponsored workshops or paid training sessions teaching teams how to adopt a disciplined AI-agent workflow.

steal_this: Package three or four of the most popular skills into a single 'AI coding agent starter kit' and sell it as a one-time download to developers just getting into agent-based coding.
